label: IIoT Ingestion Pipeline
info:
Input -> Math -> Stateful Ops -> Synthetic -> Standardize -> InfluxDB out

See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for the full explanation of each stage.

To go live at a client site: disable/delete the 'Simulated Machine Input' inject + 'Generate Raw Reading' function, and wire a real protocol node (MQTT in, Modbus Read, OPC-UA Item, etc.) into 'Math - Engineering Units' instead, matching the raw payload shape documented on that function node.

name: 1. INPUT  (replace simulator with MQTT / Modbus / OPC-UA in production)
Input: Generate Raw Reading (simulator)
2. MATH  (scale raw counts to engineering units)
Math: Engineering Units
3. STATEFUL OPS  (rolling averages, run-state, uptime via flow context)
Stateful Ops: Rolling Stats & Run-State
4. SYNTHETIC  (composite/derived metrics not on any single sensor)
Synthetic: Derived Metrics
5. STANDARDIZE  (shape point for InfluxDB line protocol)
Standardize: Prep for InfluxDB
If you see this, then flows.json changes are persistent!
